Name: Custom Combined Rings
Author: besworks
Description:
[size=6][u][b][youtube]Eub7BSAMlCc[/youtube]

Custom Combined Rings[/b][/u][/size]

Make your Stardew Valley Combined Rings truly unique!

[list]
[*]Choose from a variety of included styles or add your own
[*]Set colors: No Effect, Single Color Tinting, Dual Color Phasing or Prismatic
[*]Set up custom rules for any combination of rings
[*]Easily configure rules through an in-game menu
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31636]Works with any ring texture pack[/url]﻿
[/list]
[u][size=4][b]📚 How to Use[/b][/size][/u]

[b]1. Access the Config Menu[/b]

[list]
[*]Visit the [b]Forge[/b] and look for the new button
[*]Type [b]ringrules[/b] in the SMAPI console
[*]Press [b]F6[/b] at the title screen
[/list]
[b]2. Create some Rules[/b]

[list]
[*]Open the config menu
[*]Pick your rings or use the [b]Any[/b] wildcard
[*]Choose the style of ring to create with this combo
[*]Add some color! Or don't, it's up to you!
[/list]
[b]3. Combine Rings[/b]

[list]
[*]Use the forge to combine some rings
[*]Rules apply automatically and persist across saves
[*]Modified rules apply without re-forging your rings
[*]Completely customize your entire set of rings!
[/list][b][size=4][u]
🎨 Customization[/u][/size][/b]

Want to use your own ring designs? Just add your PNG files to the [b]assets/sprites[/b] folder.

This mod completely bypasses the normal combined ring rendering. No need to worry about your ring textures getting shredded by a glitchy animation. Just add any 16x16 sprite you want to use and enjoy. There are no positioning or special requirements at all. Gray-scale images work best with the coloring features but full color sprites are fully supported.

[b][size=4][u]👍Feedback[/u][/size][/b]

If you enjoy this mod or need help, feel free to:

[list]
[*]Leave a comment
[*]Make a suggestion
[*]Share your cool combinations!
[/list]
[u][size=4][b]🚩Known Issues[/b][/size][/u]

[list]
[*]None that I'm aware of. Let me know if you find any.
[/list]
